description:
Per workspace AGENTS.md canonical-template rule, jmap-mail-server is the canonical extension-server template; this is the first extension wire-up after foundation .41.1.

## Scope

Add `enforce_max_objects_in_set(&args, backend.max_objects_in_set(caller, &account_id))?;` immediately after the `account_exists` gate in all 6 mail-server /set handlers:

1. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mailbox.rs `handle_mailbox_set`
2. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs `handle_email_set`
3. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/identity.rs `handle_identity_set`
4. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/submission.rs `handle_submission_set`
5. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/sieve.rs `handle_sieve_set`
6. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/vacation.rs `handle_vacation_set`

Insertion shape:

```rust
let (account_id, mut args) = extract_account_id(args)?;
if !backend.account_exists(caller, &account_id).await.map_err(|e| server_fail_from_backend(&e))? {
    return Err(JmapError::account_not_found());
}
jmap_server::helpers::enforce_max_objects_in_set(
    &args,
    backend.max_objects_in_set(caller, &account_id),
)?;
```

For vacation (singleton VacationResponse) the cap is moot in practice but applying the same code keeps the canonical template uniform.

## Tests

For each handler: integration test asserting Err(JmapError) with error_type==\"limit\" and description==\"maxObjectsInSet\" when over-limit /set is dispatched. Independent oracle — hand-built JmapError.

For one (Mailbox/set): positive test at exactly the limit returning Ok.

## Acceptance

- cargo fmt --all clean
- cargo clippy -p jmap-mail-server -- -D warnings clean
- cargo test -p jmap-mail-server passes
- RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc -p jmap-mail-server --no-deps clean
- No existing test batches >500 /set entries

## Canonical-template propagation

This is the canonical extension-server template; .41.3-.9 mirror this pattern exactly.
title: Wire maxObjectsInSet enforcement into jmap-mail-server (6 handlers — canonical extension-server template)
